query:
SELECT m.sponsorId, s.companyName, COUNT(*) as meetingCount, MIN(m.timeSlot) as minSlot, MAX(m.timeSlot) as maxSlot
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
GROUP BY m.sponsorId, s.companyName;
